added_findings.title: VV's 3D hotkeys are global: the KeyScope port must gate VV's own hotkey handler, not only the drawing keys
added_findings.detail: TV's KeyScope (03__AppUtils/Na__AppUtils__KeyScope__.js 1.1.0, TV v2.110.0 'Three Tool Sets, Three Keyboards', plus v2.115.0) exists because the 3D model's keys answered under every tab (its header: 'T on a drawing picked the Text tool AND put the hidden model into Walk mode'). TV's 3D hotkey manager returns unless the MODEL scope is live (10__NavigationAndCameras/Na__Hotkeys__Manager.js L84, L167) and the mode controller feeds the scope (ModeController L389, L654-655, L1182). KeyScope's PORT NOTE: 'ValeVision's own hotkey handler and its Layout Editor have the same shape, so the same leaf fits.' VV's 3D hotkeys are a different module: 03__AppUtils/Na__AppUtils__ValeVision__HotkeyHandler__.js (initialised at Index.html L1792) adds one window keydown listener that skips only focused inputs (L53, L91-101) and binds R, B, T, Y, V, PageUp, PageDown, 1-9, Backspace and Shift+F (02__AppData/Na__ValeVision__HotkeysDictionary__.json). VV's Controls__Pc also listens on window (L360) with no stopPropagation, so both keyboards hear every key. Code-traced, not run: letters typed on a VV drawing very likely act on the hidden 3D model today (the Index.html callbacks guard only on walk-enabled, carousel-visible and not-flying), and porting Controls__Pc 1.3.0's Page Up/Down adds the page keys to that set whenever the carousel counts as visible. The survey's F38/WP-S03b-09 list KeyScope but not VV's 3D handler.
added_findings.recommendation: In WP-S03b-09R (coordinated with the keyboard/mode-controller slice): port KeyScope and make VV's Na__AppUtils__ValeVision__HotkeyHandler__ (or its Index.html callbacks) return unless Na__KeyScope__Is(Na__KeyScope__MODEL), and use Na__KeyScope__IsTypingTarget instead of its own input test, as TV's Na__Hotkeys__Manager does. Keep VV's file names (the 3D dictionary stays 02__AppData/Na__ValeVision__HotkeysDictionary__.json; TV's is Na__Hotkeys__3dModelTab__.json - a naming question for the config slice). Acceptance: with a drawing open, R, B, T, Y, V, 1-9, PageUp and PageDown change nothing in the 3D view; on the 3D tab they work as today.
added_findings.evidence: TV Na__AppUtils__KeyScope__.js header L12-40, PORT NOTE L66-69, exports L225-233; TV Na__Hotkeys__Manager.js L84, L167; TV ModeController L319, L389, L616, L654-655, L1182, L1219; VV Na__AppUtils__ValeVision__HotkeyHandler__.js L53, L91-101, L113-135; VV Index.html L1792 (callback guards); VV Na__ValeVision__HotkeysDictionary__.json bindings; VV Controls__Pc L360; TV DEVLOG v2.110.0 (index L5496).

notes: Slice quality is high: the 44-row schema table, the round trip on the 4 real VV sheets, the import closure and the late-start/Common-seed trace all hold line by line. No finding is refuted. The errors were small, but each would mislead a swarm agent: three false 'VV lacks' sub-claims (Na__DrawData__GetBlock, Na__LeScope__IsInside and Na__LeMargin__Push already exist in VV), a wrong WP-S03b-03 acceptance line (TV's normaliser also adds Asset__Samples null and depthFog), and a Styles__Main action mismatch. Material omissions were wiring and process, not schema: (1) VV's 3D hotkeys are a global window listener that KeyScope must gate, or keys typed on a drawing also drive the hidden model (S03b-V01); (2) 53 ProjectLink imports two ProjectLoader functions VV lacks, so ShapeGeometry 1.6.0+, QrCell and Modern 1.5.0 fail at link time even with the QR off (S03b-V02); (3) TV PORT NOTEs make DimensionRounding, ShapeRings and later LeaderGeometry wait for Adam's sign-off, and SheetRecords 1.38.0+ imports ShapeRings (D-S03b-11). What to watch: use the R versions of WP-02/03/06/07/09; treat RenumberSheets' no-op as a recorded VV seam (TV falls back to config numbering); never ship TrueVision__Pwa__HasUnsavedWork, 'NOBLE ARCHITECTURE', noble-architecture.com/q/ or the PlanVision pdfJsScriptPath into VV. F07, F26 and V01 are code-traced only, and R2 data was not inspected. The report is edited in place with [Verifier] marks and a Verification section; scripts are in scratchpad/parity/verify_s03b/v3 (import_closure.py, setupkeys_cmp.py, patch_report*.py), with a pre-edit backup at verify_s03b/v3/report_backup_before_verifier.md.
